verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. مَزْمُورٌ اِسْمَعُوا هَذَا يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلشُّعُوبِ. أَصْغُوا يَا جَمِيعَ سُكَّانِ ٱلدُّنْيَا،
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Hear this, all [ye] people; give ear, all [ye] inhabitants of the world:
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

verses.ar: عَالٍ وَدُونٍ، أَغْنِيَاءَ وَفُقَرَاءَ، سَوَاءً.
verses.kjv: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.web: both low and high, rich and poor together.

verses.ar: فَمِي يَتَكَلَّمُ بِٱلْحِكَمِ، وَلَهَجُ قَلْبِي فَهْمٌ.
verses.kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart [shall be] of understanding.
verses.web: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

verses.ar: أُمِيلُ أُذُنِي إِلَى مَثَلٍ، وَأُوضِّحُ بِعُودٍ لُغْزِي.
verses.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

verses.ar: لِمَاذَا أَخَافُ فِي أَيَّامِ ٱلشَّرِّ عِنْدَمَا يُحِيطُ بِي إِثْمُ مُتَعَقِّبِيَّ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَّكِلُونَ عَلَى ثَرْوَتِهِمْ، وَبِكَثْرَةِ غِنَاهُمْ يَفْتَخِرُونَ.
verses.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

verses.ar: ٱلْأَخُ لَنْ يَفْدِيَ ٱلْإِنْسَانَ فِدَاءً، وَلَا يُعْطِيَ ٱللهَ كَفَّارَةً عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.web: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

verses.ar: وَكَرِيمَةٌ هِيَ فِدْيَةُ نُفُوسِهِمْ، فَغَلِقَتْ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ.
verses.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
verses.web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

verses.ar: حَتَّى يَحْيَا إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ فَلَا يَرَى ٱلْقَبْرَ.
verses.kjv: That he should still live for ever, [and] not see corruption.
verses.web: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

verses.ar: بَلْ يَرَاهُ! ٱلْحُكَمَاءُ يَمُوتُونَ. كَذَلِكَ ٱلْجَاهِلُ وَٱلْبَلِيدُ يَهْلِكَانِ، وَيَتْرُكَانِ ثَرْوَتَهُمَا لِآخَرِينَ.
verses.kjv: For he seeth [that] wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

verses.ar: بَاطِنُهُمْ أَنَّ بُيُوتَهُمْ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ، مَسَاكِنَهُمْ إِلَى دَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ. يُنَادُونَ بِأَسْمَائِهِمْ فِي ٱلْأَرَاضِي.
verses.kjv: Their inward thought [is, that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [and] their dwelling places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names.
verses.web: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

verses.ar: وَٱلْإِنْسَانُ فِي كَرَامَةٍ لَا يَبِيتُ. يُشْبِهُ ٱلْبَهَائِمَ ٱلَّتِي تُبَادُ.
verses.kjv: Nevertheless man [being] in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts [that] perish.
verses.web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

verses.ar: هَذَا طَرِيقُهُمُ ٱعْتِمَادُهُمْ، وَخُلَفَاؤُهُمْ يَرْتَضُونَ بِأَقْوَالِهِمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: This their way [is] their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

verses.ar: مِثْلَ ٱلْغَنَمِ لِلْهَاوِيَةِ يُسَاقُونَ. ٱلْمَوْتُ يَرْعَاهُمْ، وَيَسُودُهُمُ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُونَ. غَدَاةً وَصُورَتُهُمْ تَبْلَى. ٱلْهَاوِيَةُ مَسْكَنٌ لَهُمْ.
verses.kjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.web: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱللهُ يَفْدِي نَفْسِي مِنْ يَدِ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ لِأَنَّهُ يَأْخُذُنِي. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.web: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

verses.ar: لَا تَخْشَ إِذَا ٱسْتَغْنَى إِنْسَانٌ، إِذَا زَادَ مَجْدُ بَيْتِهِ.
verses.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.web: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ كُلَّهُ لَا يَأْخُذُ. لَا يَنْزِلُ وَرَاءَهُ مَجْدُهُ.
verses.kjv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.web: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ فِي حَيَاتِهِ يُبَارِكُ نَفْسَهُ، وَيَحْمَدُونَكَ إِذَا أَحْسَنْتَ إِلَى نَفْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and [men] will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.web: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

verses.ar: تَدْخُلُ إِلَى جِيلِ آبَائِهِ، ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُعَايِنُونَ ٱلنُّورَ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ.
verses.kjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.web: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

verses.ar: إِنْسَانٌ فِي كَرَامَةٍ وَلَا يَفْهَمُ يُشْبِهُ ٱلْبَهَائِمَ ٱلَّتِي تُبَادُ.
verses.kjv: Man [that is] in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts [that] perish.
verses.web: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
